text: In 2019, the City of Toronto entered into a 15-year lease (comprising an initial 10-year term with one 5-year extension option) for 233 Carlton Street, a three-storey commercial building of approximately 13,000 square feet located in Cabbagetown, at a total lease cost of $6 million. The site was selected to replace the Adelaide Women's Resource Centre at 67 Adelaide Street East — a City-owned property — and to be operated as a 24-hour women's drop-in centre, with the lease commencing January 1, 2020. The property owner was also exempted from property taxes for the full duration of the rental period. An initial renovation estimate of $3.7 million was established for the site and was documented on the Delegated Approval Form tied to the lease.
